items.raw_excerpt: Experts say people considering freezing their eggs for non-medical reasons need more evidence-based information as most will not use them and, even if they do, the procedure is not a guaranteed pathway to parenthood.
items.summary_en: Freezing your eggs without a medical reason costs a lot of money. Experts say most women never use the eggs they freeze. Even when they do, it does not always lead to a baby.
items.summary_ko: 의학적 이유 없이 난자를 냉동하는 데는 많은 돈이 듭니다. 전문가들은 대부분의 여성이 냉동한 난자를 결국 사용하지 않는다고 말합니다. 사용하더라도 항상 임신으로 이어지는 것은 아닙니다.
items.title_en: Elective egg freezing costs thousands, but most women never use them
items.title_ko: 비의학적 난자 냉동, 비용은 많이 들지만 대부분 사용하지 않아
items.title_original: Elective egg freezing costs thousands, but most women never use them
